Hey LinkedIn network! 🚀

Do you know any experts with hands-on experience in digital building access projects? I’m on the lookout for professionals skilled in:
✅ SDK development for React Native
✅ GoLang
✅ C# (integrations, especially with Microsoft Places)
✅ Applications for digital building access (💡 must-have!)

This could start with a partial consultation or supporting the pre-sales process. If anyone comes to mind, I’d love your recommendations! Let’s connect and make things happen. 🙌
